name: Deadwood R.I.P

features.name: xSplit Reel Split Wild
features.description: Two Diamondback scatters split a reel.

review:
A western on a 3-4-4-4-2 layout where the fifth reel is special: every symbol there counts double. Stacked xNudge wilds land on the middle reels, and two Diamondback scatters switch on an xSplit wild that halves and doubles symbols on its reel.

A revolver cylinder triggers Quick Draw, and xRip adds Nolimit's high-risk extras. Extreme volatility, a 100,000x max and an 8% hit rate – wins are rare by design, so the demo is the place for it.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
